query: Why some deep sea creatures are transparent?
title: Why some deep sea creatures are transparent?
description:
Transparency reduces the shadow and outline of an animal in open water. Where there is little structure to hide behind, clear tissues can make a creature harder for predators and prey to detect from multiple directions.
